description:
The Talon community command set has a global settings file at C:\Users\Docker\AppData\Roaming\Talon\user\community\settings.talon. This file is currently open in the text editor and contains various Talon configuration options.

Your task is to make the following three changes to the settings:
1. Change the imgui.scale setting from 1.3 to 1.5 (to make the help UI larger)
2. Uncomment the line 'speech.timeout = 0.3' by removing the leading '# ' (this enables the speech processing timeout)
3. Change the user.command_history_display setting from 10 to 20 (to show more command history lines)

After making all three changes, save the file with Ctrl+S.
